overview.lead: Rogues are melee damage dealers built on Energy, combo points, stealth and poisons. Blizzard says any Rogue spec has a place in a group thanks to stealth and control, and poisons stay a Rogue-only tool.

points.text: Specs at a glance: Assassination uses daggers, poisons, Mutilate and Venom. Combat takes any weapon and owns the only Rogue cleave, Blade Flurry. Subtlety mixes bleeds, stealth openers and combat tricks.

Rogues can now use one-handed axes (Alliance trainer: Buliwyf Stonehand in Ironforge, per Warcraft Tavern). Racials changed late: Human Ruthless is +1% crit and Dwarf Artisan's Precision is +1% hit (26 Oct).

101.summary: What every Rogue should know before choosing a spec.

overview.lead: Assassination uses daggers and poisons. Mutilate strikes with both daggers, and Shank triggers the Venom passive when talented.

points.text: Poisons now scale with Attack Power and can crit, so better gear raises your poison damage too.
Warcraft Tavern expects Assassination to do well in most raid fights.

101.summary: Leveling, the core rotation and the habits that matter first.

steps.text: Warcraft Tavern advises against Assassination as a starter spec until you reach Mutilate at the 21-point tier.
Remorseless Attacks raises the crit chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate or Ghostly Strike after a kill (20% at rank 1).
Mutilate needs a dagger in each hand, so carry two daggers by the time you take it.
Do the poisons quest from level 20 (it needs 80 Lockpicking); Deadly Poison arrives at 30.
Keep poisons on both weapons; they have more charges now, and Improved Poisons can save a charge.
Build combo points with Mutilate: 2 per cast, and Seal Fate can add one more when it crits.
Maintain Slice and Dice. Use Shank for Energy and, with Venom, a short poison buff. Coordinate Expose Armor with your group.
Use Cold Blood to make your next Mutilate or Eviscerate crit.
Spend spare combo points on Eviscerate.
Energy now regenerates smoothly at about 10 per second instead of in 20-point ticks, so there is no tick timing to learn (talentsforever data).
Rogues learn Shank at level 24 and its second rank at 44. With Venom, Shank briefly raises poison damage and application chance.
Poisons can now share a weapon with a sharpening stone or weightstone.
Lethality now takes two points. Check the current tree when planning a build from the October snapshot.

omitted.reason: The spec overview above covers this.

201.summary: Stat priorities, raid duties, consumables and PvP.

steps.text: Sap no longer breaks your Stealth, but since 24 September sapping a PvP-flagged player flags you.
Cold Blood and a poisoned Mutilate give burst, and Improved Kidney Shot makes stunned targets take more damage from your poisons and attacks (5% at rank 1).
Warcraft Tavern names Human (Will to Survive breaks stuns) and Gnome (Escape Artist) as strong Alliance PvP races.
Against Warrior: Improved Berserker Rage can now remove movement-impairing effects, so a Crippling Poison slow may not hold, and Victory Rush heals them after kills.
Against Hunter: Hunters can lay traps mid-fight on a 30-second cooldown, and Entrapment can root you on a Frost Trap's first hit. Wyvern Sting is gone, and Auto Shot needs a brief stand-still.

overview.lead: Combat works with any weapon and hits hard with direct strikes. Blade Flurry is the only Rogue cleave: 20% attack speed and an extra target for your swings for 15 seconds.

points.text: Hack and Slash replaces the old weapon specializations: axes and swords get extra attacks, daggers and fist weapons get crit, and maces ignore armor.
It supports Sinister Strike and Backstab play alike, since Puncturing Wounds and Aggression now boost Backstab too.

101.summary: Leveling, the core rotation and the habits that matter first.

steps.text: Warcraft Tavern points to Combat as the easiest leveling spec; its build takes Deflection, Riposte, Blade Flurry and Flawless Execution.
Blade Flurry lets you fight two mobs at once, and Riposte adds a strong hit and a disarm after parries.
Endurance shortens Sprint and Evasion cooldowns (30% at rank 1), which helps when a pull goes wrong.
Dual Specialization unlocks at level 40, so you can keep a leveling spec beside a group spec.
Keep Slice and Dice up and build combo points with Sinister Strike, or Backstab from behind with a dagger.
Spend 5 combo points on Eviscerate; Flawless Execution makes it 10 Energy cheaper.
Use Blade Flurry when two or more enemies stand close.
Use Adrenaline Rush (double Energy regeneration for 15 seconds) for burst.
Riposte lights up after you parry: 150% weapon damage and a 6-second disarm.
Axes are new for Rogues, and Hack and Slash gives them the same extra-attack chance as swords.
Weapon Expertise now lowers the target's dodge and parry instead of adding weapon skill.
Deflection now gives 2% parry per point, so Riposte comes up more often.
Dual Wield Specialization grants 25% off-hand damage at one point and 50% at two points.

omitted.reason: The spec overview above covers this.

201.summary: Stat priorities, raid duties, consumables and PvP.

steps.text: MeinMMO rates Combat's PvP as weak next to Subtlety.
Riposte disarms for 6 seconds after a parry, Improved Kick can silence for 2 seconds, and Improved Sprint can clear slows.
Endurance shortens Sprint and Evasion cooldowns, which helps you escape or reset a fight.

overview.lead: Subtlety can build around Hemorrhage, Rupture and Garrote bleeds or use Ambush and other stealth openers.

points.text: Hemorrhage boosts your Rupture and Garrote damage by 15%. Death Mark rewards timing those bleeds inside its six-second window.
Premeditation, Preparation and Dirty Deeds give it strong openers and resets.

101.summary: Leveling, the core rotation and the habits that matter first.

steps.text: Subtlety's key talents sit deep in the tree, so it is weak early, and guides point new Rogues to Combat for leveling.
Ghostly Strike (row 3) is a builder that adds 15% dodge for 7 seconds, handy against hard-hitting mobs.
Dirty Deeds lets you Garrote from the front and makes Cheap Shot and Garrote cheaper.
Open from stealth with Garrote or Ambush; Initiative can add an extra combo point (33% at rank 1).
Keep Rupture on the target and build combo points with Hemorrhage.
When talented, use Death Mark just before damage you want it to store. It counts Garrote and Rupture damage at twice the rate.
Keep Slice and Dice up and refresh Rupture before it falls off.
Use Ghostly Strike to open a seven-second window for a Garrote or Ambush without Stealth.
Sap no longer breaks Stealth, and Dirty Tricks makes Sap and Blind cheaper.
Ghostly Strike gives your next Ambush or Garrote within seven seconds a way to skip the Stealth requirement.
Setup and Initiative now reach 100% at 3 points, per Blizzard.
Serrated Blades makes your attacks ignore part of the target's armor and boosts Rupture.

omitted.reason: The spec overview above covers this.

201.summary: Stat priorities, raid duties, consumables and PvP.

steps.text: MeinMMO calls Subtlety the strong PvP Rogue build, though its dagger play asks you to stay behind your target.
Premeditation (now 16 points deep, with its combo points lasting 20 seconds), Preparation and Dirty Deeds (Garrote from the front) power your openers and resets.
Distract remains a utility tool. Improved Distract was removed, and Quick Getaway grants extra Sap capacity and a brief movement boost.
Against Warrior: Arms Warriors bring Mortal Strike's 50% healing cut and Improved Hamstring's root, and Improved Berserker Rage can clear your slows.

Against Hunter: Hunters can lay traps mid-fight on a 30-second cooldown, and Entrapment can root you on a Frost Trap's first hit. Wyvern Sting is gone, and Auto Shot needs a brief stand-still, so stay close.
